method: Public publisher and author/institution sources only. Crossref verifies bibliographic identity, not recipe fidelity. HTTP responses, full text, abstract-only access and source gaps are recorded separately. Catalogue price quotes were not re-priced in this literature-only audit. No article/PDF/SI is included in distributable files.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: Ni/Pt(111) simulations and 10 wt% CoMoFeNiCu/carbon nanofibers are not a 12 wt% Ni/gamma-alumina recipe.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: Exact gamma-alumina grade, loading, 550-700 C window and manufacture remain engineering assumptions.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: The paper uses 10 wt% Ni on CeO2-x/CNT with CeO2:CNT = 0.5 by mass, NaBH4 reduction and light.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: 15/15/70 wt% Ni/CeO2/MgO, thermal activity and the generic oxide route are not reproduced experiments.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: Ru/MgO paper uses 3.1 wt% Ru and Ru3(CO)12 on preferential MgO(111); GaN-supported Ru is light-driven.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: 3 wt% Ru on generic MgO with chloride-price markup and wet impregnation remains a grade and route proxy.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: The primary abstract verifies 5 wt% Co impregnation and an optimum Mg/La molar ratio of 5; tests span 300-550 C at atmospheric pressure.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: The 85/10 wt% MgO/La2O3 split is not that ratio. A review-transcribed 92% conversion was not independently reverified. Bell concerns alumina.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: Balcar reports an optimum 9-15 wt% elemental Re on organized mesoporous alumina.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: The input retains 8 wt% elemental Re, generic alumina and a 25-100 C screening band; these are not the verified optimum recipe.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.outcome: Mismatched primary removed; review context retained
candidate_findings.verified_scope: Handzlik studies molybdena rather than tungsten and was removed from this candidate.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: No proprietary OCT composition or silica grade was verified. The input is 7 wt% elemental W, not 7 wt% WO3.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: Handzlik directly studies supported Mo using thermal spreading of MoO2(acac)2. Merle concerns grafted Mo species on silica; Le Roux concerns W alkane metathesis.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: 8 wt% elemental Mo, silica/alumina ratio and generic wet route remain assumptions. The wrong W paper was removed and the direct Mo comparison linked.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.outcome: Bibliographic architecture confirmed; experimental access gap
candidate_findings.verified_scope: Primary title and Crossref metadata identify supported W hydride and direct ethylene-to-propylene chemistry.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: Free experimental full text/SI, 4 wt% loading, 120-250 C window and air-free precursor manufacturing cost were not verified.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.outcome: Primary public abstract contradicts broad selectivity claim
candidate_findings.verified_scope: At 300 C, m-cresol on Pt/silica shows faster hydrogenation/dehydrogenation than HDO; titania/zirconia increase toluene selectivity.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: No general arene-preserving guarantee follows. 1 wt% Pt, silica grade and 250-400 C band remain assumptions; other catalyst architectures are no longer direct evidence.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: The paper describes surface Co-Mo-S phases in Co-incorporated MoS2 nanosulfide. Issue year is 2019, online publication 2018.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: 12/4/84 wt% Mo/Co/alumina and sulfur inventory are not established by the accessible text.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.outcome: Primary publisher full text via web retrieval; direct HTTP blocked
candidate_findings.verified_scope: Ni1Mo3N/C uses 1:3 Ni/Mo molar ratio, glucose-derived carbon and sol-gel preparation; 500 C H2 treatment forms nitride/carbide phases. Phenolics tests use 220-260 C.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: 5/10/85 wt% Ni/Mo/activated-carbon, 250-380 C and generic impregnation are not that experiment. No new numerical performance value was adopted.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.verified_scope: 5 wt% Ru/C at 350 C, 200 bar gave maximum 65 wt% oil yield at 4 h with 5 wt% catalyst intake relative to oil.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: Ru loading and catalyst intake have different denominators. Simultaneous 90 wt% deoxygenation, exact carbon grade and manufacturing route were not verified.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.outcome: Primary full PDF and institutional abstract
candidate_findings.verified_scope: The commercial case ran about 200 C for 18,000 h; virgin XRF shows 3.51 wt% V2O5 and 6.36 wt% WO3. The washcoat paper studies printed alumina lattices.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: 2.5/7/90.5 wt% inputs and 260-420 C are not this service case. Fibers, grade, forming and substrate geometry remain unresolved.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.outcome: Primary author abstract; full-methods access gap
candidate_findings.verified_scope: Kwak compares Cu-SSZ-13 with Cu-beta and Cu-ZSM-5; the primary abstract reports activity/selectivity advantages. Cu pairing is mechanistic context.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: 2.5 wt% Cu, Si/Al, matched hydrothermal aging, washcoat mass and the 200-500 C band were not validated as one recipe. The prior sole-preprint statement was removed.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.

candidate_findings.outcome: Primary public abstract; review framework mismatch
candidate_findings.verified_scope: Long-Yang reports nearly complete NO conversion at 400-500 C with strong exchange-level and Si/Al effects. The Gao review concerns other, small-pore frameworks.
candidate_findings.remaining_gap: The small-pore stability claim is not proof for ZSM-5. 2 wt% Fe, grade, 300-550 C band and manufacturing recipe remain assumptions.
candidate_findings.score_policy: Authored performance, readiness and route assessments are separate from experimental performance and pricing-provenance confidence.
